backlog.spec: Add all rdkit.Chem.Descriptors.descList descriptors (computed per molecule, nan_to_num, clip to +-1e6) concatenated with the Morgan bits as features for the random forest. Keep other settings unchanged.
backlog.title: RDKit 2D descriptors + RF

backlog.spec: Replace the RF with LightGBM (n_estimators 800, learning_rate 0.03, num_leaves 31, colsample_bytree 0.5, subsample 0.8 with subsample_freq 1, n_jobs 8, random_state seed) on RDKit 2D descriptors plus Crippen/MolLogP, using nan_to_num and clipping.
backlog.title: Descriptors only LightGBM

backlog.spec: Switch Morgan features to count fingerprints via GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy with radius 3 and 2048 bits, keep RF.
backlog.title: Count Morgan fingerprints

backlog.spec: Use CatBoostRegressor (iterations 1500, depth 6, learning_rate 0.05, loss MAE or RMSE, thread_count 8, random_seed seed, verbose 0) on RDKit descriptors plus count Morgan radius 2 with 1024 bits.
backlog.title: Descriptors + counts into CatBoost

backlog.spec: Average predictions of RF (on fingerprints+descriptors), LightGBM and CatBoost on the same feature matrix. Equal weights.
backlog.title: Ensemble RF + LightGBM + CatBoost

backlog.spec: Train LightGBM with objective huber (alpha 1.0) instead of L2 on descriptor+fingerprint features, since the metric is MAE.
backlog.title: MAE/Huber objective for GBM

backlog.spec: Replace RandomForest with ExtraTreesRegressor (500 trees, max_features 0.3, min_samples_leaf 1) on fingerprints+descriptors.
backlog.title: Extra trees

backlog.spec: Append the 167 MACCS keys (rdkit.Chem.MACCSkeys.GenMACCSKeys) to the features of the existing pipeline.
backlog.title: Add MACCS keys

backlog.spec: Concatenate Morgan counts with atom-pair count fingerprints (1024 bits) and topological torsion counts (1024 bits) from rdFingerprintGenerator; use with LightGBM.
backlog.title: Atom-pair and torsion count fingerprints

backlog.spec: Add functional-class Morgan fingerprints (GetMorganFeatureAtomInvGen, radius 3, 1024 bits, counts) to the ECFP features.
backlog.title: Feature-Morgan (FCFP) added

backlog.spec: Implement SVR (sklearn, kernel precomputed) with a Tanimoto/MinMax kernel on Morgan count fingerprints, C=5, epsilon 0.1; compute kernel with numpy.
backlog.title: SVR with Tanimoto kernel

backlog.spec: Fit KernelRidge with precomputed MinMax kernel on count fingerprints (alpha 0.5), average with the RF predictions 50/50.
backlog.title: Kernel ridge Tanimoto + RF blend

backlog.spec: Closed-form GP regression with MinMax kernel on count Morgan, noise 0.3, mean-centered targets; return posterior mean.
backlog.title: Gaussian process on Tanimoto kernel

backlog.spec: sklearn MLPRegressor (256,128 hidden, early_stopping, alpha 1e-3) on QuantileTransformer/standard-scaled descriptors; bag 5 seeds and average.
backlog.title: MLP on descriptors

backlog.spec: Set MIN_SAMPLES_LEAF=2, MAX_FEATURES=0.2 and N_TREES=500 for the RF.
backlog.title: RF min_samples_leaf and max_features tuning

backlog.spec: Drop fingerprint columns that are active in fewer than 5 training molecules before fitting, applied consistently to test.
backlog.title: Remove low-variance bits

backlog.spec: Add features: sums of Crippen atomic logP contributions binned by atom-type (rdMolDescriptors._CalcCrippenContribs, summed per type index) plus total MolLogP and TPSA, MR, to the fingerprints.
backlog.title: Crippen contributions per-atom features

backlog.spec: Fit the model to y minus MolLogP (Crippen) as target, then add MolLogP back to predictions; use RF/LightGBM on fingerprints+descriptors.
backlog.title: Residual learning on Crippen logP

backlog.spec: Preprocess SMILES: keep the largest fragment (rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser) and neutralize charges (Uncharger) before featurization.
backlog.title: Salt stripping and neutralization

backlog.spec: Add SMARTS-count features for carboxylic acid, aliphatic amine, amidine, sulfonamide, phenol, tetrazole, quaternary N, and pyridine-like N, appended to the features.
backlog.title: Ionizable group counts

backlog.spec: XGBRegressor (hist, n_estimators 1000, learning_rate 0.03, max_depth 6, subsample 0.8, colsample_bytree 0.4, reg:absoluteerror) on descriptors + Morgan counts.
backlog.title: XGBoost on mixed features

backlog.spec: Train 5 LightGBM models with different seeds and feature subsamples and average them for lower variance.
backlog.title: Multi-seed bagging of GBM

backlog.spec: Within fit_predict, create 5-fold inner out-of-fold predictions for RF, LightGBM, and SVR-Tanimoto; fit a non-negative linear regression on them and apply to the test predictions.
backlog.title: Stacking with ridge meta-learner

backlog.spec: LightGBM with learning_rate 0.01, 3000 trees, num_leaves 15, min_child_samples 10, lambda_l2 5, colsample 0.3 with an inner 10% validation split for early stopping (stopping 100).
backlog.title: Lower learning rate longer GBM

backlog.spec: Use Morgan radius 3 with 4096 bits and chirality enabled in the RF.
backlog.title: Larger radius, bigger bit vector

backlog.spec: Compute Weisfeiler-Lehman-like hashed atom environment features with atom properties (Gasteiger charge, atom logP contribution, aromaticity) pooled via sum and max over atoms into a dense vector; feed to LightGBM with descriptors.
backlog.title: Graph-style message passing features

backlog.spec: Add EState fingerprint sums (rdkit.Chem.EState.Fingerprinter.FingerprintMol, both counts and max-EState arrays) and VSA descriptors to the feature set.
backlog.title: Gasteiger-charge descriptors (EState)

backlog.spec: Clip training targets to the 1st and 99th percentiles before fitting to reduce the influence of outliers on the MAE.
backlog.title: Target winsorizing

backlog.spec: Instead of the mean of trees, return the median of per-tree predictions from the RF (np.median over estimators_ predictions), aimed at MAE.
backlog.title: Median-of-trees RF prediction

backlog.spec: Weight each training molecule by 1/sqrt(count of its Murcko scaffold in the training set) when fitting, to improve generalization to unseen scaffolds.
backlog.title: Sample-weights by scaffold frequency

backlog.spec: Add a module-level dict keyed by SMILES string that stores the per-molecule feature row (Morgan bits plus clipped descriptors) and the Crippen logP. featurize() and crippen() look up cached values and compute only missing ones. This cuts the repeated descriptor cost over the 15 fits and frees time budget for other additions. Predictions are unchanged, so it is safe to combine with later ideas.
backlog.title: Cache featurization across folds

backlog.spec: Add a fourth base model: SVR with precomputed MinMax kernel (sum of min / sum of max) on atom-pair count fingerprints (rdFingerprintGenerator.GetAtomPairGenerator, fpSize 2048, count vector). Compute the features inside featurize into a separate array and keep it out of the tree inputs. Add its column to base_preds and the inner OOF array (shape 4 columns) so the positive linear meta-learner weighs it. Use C=5, epsilon=0.1.
backlog.title: Atom-pair count fingerprint SVR as 4th stack member

backlog.spec: Add KernelRidge(kernel='precomputed', alpha=0.3) on the Morgan Tanimoto kernel as an extra stack column (on the Crippen residual). It is cheap, and its smooth predictions differ from those of SVR. Update the OOF array to 4 columns.
backlog.title: Kernel ridge Tanimoto base model

backlog.spec: In base_preds, replace the single LightGBM with the average of 3 LightGBM models using different seeds (seed, seed+1, seed+2), each with subsample 0.8 and colsample 0.3. Keep it as one stack column. This reduces variance of the boosted model.
backlog.title: Multi-seed LightGBM bagging inside stack

backlog.spec: For the ExtraTrees stack column, predict with the per-sample median across estimators_ instead of the mean (np.median over [t.predict(X) for t in et.estimators_]). Apply this to both the OOF and the final predictions. Median is robust to outliers and fits the MAE metric.
backlog.title: Median-of-trees ExtraTrees

backlog.spec: After computing y = train_y - crippen, clip y to its 1st and 99th percentiles of the training set before fitting all base models and the meta-learner. Predictions are not clipped. This reduces the pull of outlying Crippen errors on the fits.
backlog.title: Winsorize residual targets

backlog.spec: Append about 12 SMARTS-match counts to the descriptor block: carboxylic acid, aliphatic amine (primary, secondary, tertiary), amidine/guanidine, sulfonamide NH, tetrazole, phenol, quaternary N, pyridine-like N, and nitro. Use Chem.MolFromSmarts with GetSubstructMatches. These capture ionization, which drives logD and is poorly represented in fingerprints. Only the tree models see them, since the SVR uses the first N_BITS columns.
backlog.title: Ionizable group count features

backlog.spec: Replace the plain Crippen subtraction with a linear baseline. Fit a Ridge (alpha 1) on about 10 descriptors (MolLogP, TPSA, MolWt, NumHDonors, NumHAcceptors, FractionCSP3, NumRotatableBonds, and ring count) using the training set. Use its prediction as the baseline to subtract and add back. Within each fit, fit the baseline on the full training set, and the same baseline for the inner OOF.
backlog.title: Second physics baseline: blend Crippen with fitted linear correction

backlog.spec: Compute the Murcko scaffold of each training molecule (MurckoScaffold.MurckoScaffoldSmiles). Give each molecule the weight 1/sqrt(scaffold count). Pass the weights as sample_weight to ExtraTrees, LightGBM and SVR (SVR.fit takes sample_weight with a precomputed kernel). This counters overrepresented scaffolds, which fits the scaffold-split evaluation.
backlog.title: Sample weights by scaffold rarity

backlog.spec: Keep the tree features as they are. For the SVR Tanimoto kernel, build separate binary Morgan fingerprints with radius 3 and 4096 bits, stored in a separate array. Compute the kernel on these instead of the first N_BITS columns. Everything else stays the same.
backlog.title: Larger-radius Morgan hashed to 4096 bits for the kernel only

backlog.spec: Add a module-level dict keyed by SMILES string that stores the per-molecule feature row (Morgan bits plus clipped descriptors) and the Crippen logP. featurize() and crippen() look up the cache and compute only missing molecules. Nothing else changes. This cuts the runtime so that more stack members fit within 10 minutes. Expect the score to stay about the same.
backlog.title: Cache featurization across folds

backlog.spec: Add a fourth base model: SVR with a precomputed MinMax kernel on hashed atom-pair count fingerprints (rdFingerprintGenerator.GetAtomPairGenerator, fpSize 2048, GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy). MinMax kernel is sum(min)/sum(max), computed in chunks. C=5, epsilon=0.1. Fit it on the Crippen residual. Extend base_preds and the OOF matrix to 4 columns so the positive LinearRegression meta-learner weights it. Cache the fingerprints.
backlog.title: Atom-pair count SVR as 4th stack member

backlog.spec: Add sklearn KernelRidge(kernel='precomputed', alpha=0.3) on the existing Tanimoto kernel of the Morgan bits as a 4th column in base_preds. It is cheap, and its errors differ from SVR's epsilon-insensitive fit. The meta-learner is the existing positive linear regression.
backlog.title: Kernel ridge on Tanimoto as stack member

backlog.spec: In base_preds, replace the single LGBMRegressor with the average of 3 LightGBM models using seeds seed, seed+1 and seed+2 (subsample 0.8, colsample 0.3). This lowers GBM variance before stacking. Keep all other hyperparameters the same.
backlog.title: Multi-seed LightGBM bagging

backlog.spec: Compute the Murcko scaffold of each training molecule (MurckoScaffold.MurckoScaffoldSmiles). Weight each sample by 1/sqrt(count of its scaffold in the training set), normalized to mean 1. Pass sample_weight to ExtraTrees, LightGBM and SVR (SVR via sample_weight in fit). Since test folds contain unseen scaffolds, this reduces overfit to the common scaffolds.
backlog.title: Scaffold-rarity sample weights

backlog.spec: Extend the meta-learner input to [oof predictions, constant column] and fit with Ridge(alpha=1) allowing an intercept. Also add the residual-target mean shrinkage. Alternatively add the raw Crippen logP as a fourth meta feature so the stack can rescale the physics baseline. The final prediction is meta.predict(base) + cte as now. Check that the weights stay sensible.
backlog.title: Second-level meta with Crippen as input

backlog.spec: Replace the raw Crippen subtraction with a fitted baseline. Fit Ridge on a small set of descriptors (MolLogP, TPSA, MolWt, NumHDonors, NumHAcceptors, FractionCSP3, and the 12 count of ionizable groups from SMARTS) on the training fold only. Use its prediction as the baseline in place of Crippen. The tree models learn the residual, and the baseline is added back. Compute it inside fit_predict so there is no leakage.
backlog.title: Linear-corrected physics baseline

backlog.spec: Append hashed atom-pair count fingerprints (1024 bits) and topological-torsion count fingerprints (1024 bits) from rdFingerprintGenerator to the feature matrix used by ExtraTrees and LightGBM only. The SVR keeps its Morgan columns, which are first in the matrix. Log1p-transform the counts.
backlog.title: Atom-pair and torsion count features for ExtraTrees

backlog.spec: After featurizing the train set, compute the bit column sums over the Morgan block, and keep only bits set in at least 3 training molecules plus all descriptor columns. Apply the same mask to the test features. Keep the Tanimoto kernel on the original unmasked bits. This reduces noise features for ExtraTrees (max_features=0.3) and speeds the job up.
backlog.title: Drop rare fingerprint bits

backlog.spec: Replace the positive LinearRegression meta-learner with a non-negative least absolute deviation fit. Minimize mean |y - oof @ w| with scipy.optimize.minimize (method SLSQP, w>=0, start at 1/3 each). The metric is MAE, so this fits the loss directly. Leave the base models unchanged.
backlog.title: Stack-level target noise robustness: MAE-tuned meta

cand.description: Append log1p hashed atom-pair and topological-torsion count fingerprints (1024 bits each) after the existing features, so the Morgan SVR columns are unchanged.

incumbent.description: Append 8 ionizable-group SMARTS match counts (carboxylic acid, aliphatic amine, amidine, sulfonamide, phenol, tetrazole, quaternary N, pyridine-like N) to the fingerprint and descriptor features.

last_tail: the job did not finish within 600 s
memo: Helped: ExtraTrees over RF (0.7230 to 0.5744), the Crippen MolLogP residual (0.5387), and stacking ExtraTrees, LightGBM and Tanimoto-SVR on that residual (0.5134). The 8 ionizable-group SMARTS counts (slot 33) were accepted at 0.5042/0.5072 over 2 runs, so that is the new incumbent (mean 0.5057). Did not help: extra feature blocks (MACCS 0.5771, count Morgan 0.5859, Crippen atom types 0.5391, EState 0.5147), single-model swaps (GP 0.5934, SVR 0.5574, LightGBM 0.5530), ExtraTrees tuning (0.5143), Huber LightGBM (0.5154), target clipping (0.5153), dropping nested stacking (0.5211, 0.5204). Plain averaging also failed (0.5388). Crashes came from CatBoost, FCFP, MLP, XGBoost and multi-seed LightGBM additions, probably time or memory limits. Many variants sit at 0.504 to 0.515, within noise (sd 0.0042). Next: stack caching and median ExtraTrees on the SMARTS incumbent, then replicate. Try a cheap MLP or GP in the stack only if runtime stays well under 10 minutes.
